conventions.convention: The SI map uses positive G_N, c and μ0, ε0=(μ0 c²)⁻¹, α=√(4πG_N/(μ0 c⁴)), geometric field αF, M=G_N m_*/c² and a=J/(m_*c), with m_*>0. These are selected family parameters, without ADM or Komar identifications.
Outward sphere fluxes define q_e=(1/4π)∫⋆(αF), q_m=(1/4π)∫αF; SI quantities satisfy Q_e=ε0 c∫⋆F and Φ_B=∫F. The magnetic input is flux, without a universal magnetic-charge convention or quantization.
Signature is (−,+,+,+); the Hodge star uses the specified independent spacetime orientation and satisfies ⋆²=−id on two-forms.
The selected ingoing RN future orientation is N=−∂r+∂v+(f/2)∂r. It agrees with the static future orientation for f>0 and reverses the separately chosen static interior orientation for f<0.

Escape requires a single continuous future causal path, piecewise C¹ with finitely many pieces on each compact parameter segment and nonzero causal one-sided tangents, reaching arbitrarily large radius. Its boundary is relative to the selected product model.

Signed surface gravity satisfies d(g(χ,χ))=−2κχ♭ on the nonzero horizon generator. For length-normalized generators, SI angular rate, acceleration surface gravity and voltage use factors c, c² and c/α respectively; voltage uses the displayed ingoing gauge.

The redshift calculation assumes a dimensionless C² null eikonal phase, future nonzero K=(dθ)♯ along an affinely parametrized ray, and defines positive observer frequency by ν=−dθ(U)/(2π). Static observers have U=c∂x⁰/√f.
The geometric background carries AC_ω; the finite parameter substitutions and calculations introduce no full Axiom of Choice.

load_bearing.statement: For positive SI constants and m_*>0, define α=√(4πG_N/(μ0c⁴)), geometric field αF, q_e=√(G_N/(4πε0c⁴))Q_e, q_m=αΦ_B/(4π), M=G_Nm_*/c², a=J/(m_*c), and Q_geom²=q_e²+q_m². These are model-local identifications without ADM/Komar, quantization or empirical claims.

For m_*>0 and real SI electric-charge and magnetic-flux inputs, on every nonempty open positive-radius RN static domain with f≠0, the rescaled datum satisfies dF=0, ∇_aF^{ab}=0 and G_ab=κ_E T_EM, conditionally on the named current draft mathematical interfaces and the adopted Λ=0, zero-current, zero-matter model.

For m_*>0 and real SI angular-momentum and electric-charge inputs, with zero magnetic flux, the electric KN datum satisfies the adopted source-free SI Einstein–Maxwell equations on its pole-free Σ>0, Δ≠0 domains and its full-sphere exterior r>R0>4|M|, conditionally on the exact named draft interfaces. No equation extension across Δ=0 is asserted.

For the zero-magnetic-flux selected ingoing KN model with M>0 and M²≥a²+q²>0, either positive root has area 4πR_H, geometric angular rate a/R_H, signed surface gravity (r_H−r_other)/(2R_H), and displayed-gauge potential qr_H/R_H. The SI factors are c, c² and c/α. The selected escape boundary is r=r_+, conditionally on the exact draft escape theorem.

concerns.concern: The Statement permits any r with r_+<r<r_E+, but Proof 1.1 replaces this arbitrary radius with 'Take r=(r_++r_E+)/2'. This explicitly proves only a selected example. The factorization and sign argument in 2.1 already work for every radius in the stated interval, so retaining arbitrary r closes the quantifier mismatch immediately.

alerts.finding: Proof 1.1 says 'Apply the sign identity [F4] to F' to deduce divergence zero from d(⋆F)=0. Its supplier lem-emg-maxwell-current-forms begins its Statement by assuming ∇_aF^{ab}=−μ0j^b, so its stated interface cannot directly establish the missing divergence equation. The supplier's Proof 2.1 does derive the sign identity without that assumption; explicitly citing that independent derivation or reproducing it would close this citation-hypothesis gap. Batch 24's RN and KN model proofs already make this distinction explicitly.

seams_checked.note: The RN and KN model items use the equation-based Einstein–Maxwell postulate with its named zero-matter instance, Λ=0, j=0 and T^m=0. They retain the stress normalization and do not import action or existence claims.

Charged crossing and escape uses preserve M>0 and M²≥Q²>0 or M²≥a²+q²>0, the selected ingoing orientation, signed generator normalization and relative escape boundary. The uncharged RN case is proved locally rather than obtained by dropping the supplier's nonzero-charge hypothesis.

The downstream conversion and family items preserve α, the SI flux map, the RN regular-domain restriction and conditional model status. The extremal MP correspondence and RN scaling limit use the correct electric RN parameters and open exterior domains.

The page parameter map and pthm-tgr-kn-family-mechanics preserve zero magnetic flux and the c, c² and c/α conversions, without ADM/Komar or dynamical-process identification. The mechanics item explicitly uses a separate Schwarzschild supplier at a=q=0, outside the generic horizon theorem's nonzero hypothesis.
